observations.body: Martha serves, Lazarus reclines, Mary anoints, Judas objects, and Jesus answers.
observations.label: Supper roles

observations.body: Pure nard, its value, the money box, the poor, and burial are placed in one exchange.
observations.label: Ointment and money

observations.body: A crowd comes because of Jesus and Lazarus, while chief priests plan against Lazarus also.
observations.label: Widening plans

payload.posture: Stay with this witness’s people, objects, speech, sequence, and stated connections before moving to another account or later use.
payload.tension: The supper holds gift, objection, burial, public witness, and an expanding death plan together six days before Passover.
payload.title: Six days before Passover, Mary anoints Jesus at supper
